summary: The UI kit tab strip play no longer misses its hover tooltip on a loaded host (#4488): it now lets the keyboard reveal's scroll event, which the browser dispatches with the next frame, land before it hovers a tab, since RAC closes an open tooltip on scroll. Plays that wait for a tooltip also fail only after the async deadline has passed and five frames have rendered since, so a host that pauses frame production for a second no longer fails the tab strip's keyboard tooltip, which opens from a frame callback.
